footnote_text: The transaction reported herein was not timely reported due to an administrative oversight. || Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person that vest in equal installments on the first business day of each calendar month following the grant date over a period of four (4) years, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment with the Issuer through each applicable vesting date. The vested RSUs will be paid on or as promptly as practicable following the vesting date (but in no event later than March 15 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the RSUs become vested) in the form of the Issuer's common stock equal to the number of vested RSUs.
